rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (frozen page text layer) sits directly left of or just above it. Booleans take xbox_joins (box immediately left of the printed option; _1/_2/_3 follow the printed option order). Amount rows on Schedules 1-4 pair a peso comb with the 2-slot centavo comb directly right (money_joins). Schedule rows 2 and 3 print no row number, so they take the column header above row 1. The Schedule totals (sched1:txtTotalDue1, sched2/sched3:txtTotalPayment1, sched4:txtTotalRemittance1) print on the same cell as the Item 14/15B/15C/19 keys, so the item keys carry the join. Items 14-19 print with dot leaders on page 1 and have no fillable cell there, except through the page 2 totals. Multi-comb MM/DD/YYYY dates stay blank.
